name: ai4kanban-telemetry
description: The service that takes usage events in — the Worker at t.ai4kanban.dev, its D1 database, and the commands that read and forget.

scripts.deploy: env -u HTTP_PROXY -u HTTPS_PROXY -u http_proxy -u https_proxy -u ALL_PROXY -u all_proxy wrangler deploy --env=""
scripts.deploy:dev: env -u HTTP_PROXY -u HTTPS_PROXY -u http_proxy -u https_proxy -u ALL_PROXY -u all_proxy wrangler deploy --env dev
scripts.dev: env -u HTTP_PROXY -u HTTPS_PROXY -u http_proxy -u https_proxy -u ALL_PROXY -u all_proxy wrangler dev
scripts.tail: env -u HTTP_PROXY -u HTTPS_PROXY -u http_proxy -u https_proxy -u ALL_PROXY -u all_proxy wrangler tail
